Definition
[Star-shaped domain] 1. ch9:9.4.2-def-1\group Nonexistence An open set $U$ is called star-shaped with respect to $0$ provided for each $x \in \overline{U}$, the line segment \[ \{ \lambda x \mid 0 \leq \lambda \leq 1\} \] lies in $\overline{U}$.
